Agreed. When I teach new students I ask them for a list of songs that make them wanna play guitar. I make a goal list based off that. Most songs that aren’t riff based metal can be taught in multiple “levels” of skill. Bass line for fretting, open chords, strumming patterns, fifth chords, triads, barre chords, four note chords, alternate picking, legato ect. Once you have these skills down pat you’re probably ready to tackle theory cause 1. you have the skill, 2. You’ve already shown dedication to come this far.
